title: New NPC with a body
description: Making a llama NPC named Trader by searching the bodies

beats.note: facing north, so the NPC lands against the open space between the houses

beats.result: the Body step lists the 14 common bodies

beats.note: Search lists every body whose name matches

beats.result: a llama named Trader stands in front of you; chat reads Made Trader
inspect lists trader as minecraft:llama, spawned, with its position

closing: A body other than a player needs no skin, so the llama is made at once
